resources.string: Make the camera yours. Your choices are saved on this device.
Used when the last style is not remembered, or on your first launch.
Open the camera with the style you last used.
Choose a maximum resolution. Camera hardware and the selected style can limit the actual size; DH 2++ is capped at 3.2 MP.
Show a rule-of-thirds grid over the viewfinder.
Play camera feedback when taking a photo.
Use light vibration for camera controls, when enabled in Android settings.
Open the photo after saving. Turn off to keep shooting; you can still tap the thumbnail.
Read the camera guide and app information.
See how photos, permissions and local preferences are handled.
Read the licenses and notices for included software.
Restore this page’s defaults. Your current style and photos are kept.
Restore the preferences on this page, including the startup defaults, balanced resolution and shooting options. Your current camera style and saved photos are kept.
Preferences reset. Current style and photos kept.
Settings stay on this device. No account or network connection is needed.
